off.title: The public site database is not connected yet
off.hint: The internal app uses two databases: the internal one (already connected) and the public site's. Connect the second so the Friday schedule, announcements, events, and community forms can be managed here.
off.step1: Open the public site's Supabase project, Project Settings, API.
off.step2: Copy the Project URL and the service role key into the variables below (.env.local or Vercel).
off.step3: Set PUBLIC_WEB_REVALIDATE_SECRET to the public site's REVALIDATE_SECRET so changes appear instantly, then restart the app.

form.hint: What you save here becomes the public site's content. Writing in Indonesian is enough.
form.settingHint: Fields left empty change nothing on the public site.
form.translationsHint: If left empty, English and Japanese visitors see the Indonesian text.
form.blocksHint: A blank line separates paragraphs. Start lines with a hyphen to make a list.

hub.description: Information the community sees on the public site is managed here. Internal board data stays in the internal database and is never shown.
hub.instant: Changes appear on the public site right away.
hub.cached: Changes are saved instantly and appear on the public site within an hour at the latest.
hub.formsHint: Room requests and donation confirmations from the public site flow into their modules on their own. Board decisions are sent back to the public site.

transparency.title: Transparency report on the public site
transparency.hint: This month's Yen cash summary is published straight from the cash book, without retyping. Only per-category totals are shown; transaction details stay internal.

transparency.confirmUnpublish: Remove this month's report from the public site?
transparency.outdated: The cash book has changed since then; update so the numbers match.

flow.title: One piece of data, one place
flow.hint: Nothing needs to be entered twice. This table shows where each piece of information is entered and where it flows.

jumat.title: Friday schedule
jumat.text: Entered here by the worship coordinator; shown at once on the public home page and the app.

pengumuman.title: Announcements
pengumuman.text: Written here by the secretary or director; shown on the public site.

agenda.title: Activities and events
agenda.text: Internal activities are recorded under Activities; those for the community go to the public site with one button.

ruangan.title: Room bookings
ruangan.text: The community requests on the public site; it arrives under Rooms, the director decides, and the answer returns to the public site.

donasi.title: Donations
donasi.text: Confirmations from the public site arrive under Donations. They count as income only after the treasurer matches them to the bank statement.

laporan.title: Financial report
laporan.text: The treasurer records cash here; the monthly summary is published to the public transparency page from Reports.

rekening.title: Accounts, donation programs, contact
rekening.text: Changed here by the treasurer, director, or secretary; the public site always shows the latest version.

kotakmasuk.title: Registrations and suggestions
kotakmasuk.text: They arrive in the Community inbox. TPA registrants become students and facility suggestions become damage reports with one button.

internal.title: Board-only data
internal.text: Cash, requests, bills, budgets, congregants, new Muslims, TPA attendance, inventory, letters, and logs exist only in the internal database and never appear on the public site.

inbox.programsHint: Registrants for TPA, classes, and other programs from the public site.
inbox.suggestionsHint: Sent by the community through the public suggestion form.
inbox.contactsHint: Messages from the public contact page.
